result.instructions: Tools for Instatus, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Instatus data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run instatus_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run instatus_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run instatus_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. instatus_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: instatus_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List all status pages on the account — each page's id, subdomain, name, status, url, custom domain, and timestamps. The page id is what every other tool takes as `page_id`. Instatus: GET /v2/pages.

tools.name: instatus_list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: List a status page's components — id, name, description, status, order, showUptime, grouped, archived. The component ids are what you set impact on. Instatus: GET /v2/{page_id}/components.

tools.name: instatus_get_component
tools.title: Get component
tools.description: Get a single component by id — its full state (name, description, status, order, showUptime, grouped, archived). Instatus: GET /v2/{page_id}/components/{component_id}.

tools.name: instatus_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List a status page's incidents, most recent first — optionally filtered by status. Each incident: id, name, status, impact, affected components, updates, timestamps. Instatus: GET /v1/{page_id}/incidents.

status.description: Filter to incidents with this status (INVESTIGATING, IDENTIFIED, MONITORING, RESOLVED).

tools.name: instatus_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by id — its full state including its update timeline and affected components. Instatus: GET /v1/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: instatus_list_maintenances
tools.title: List maintenances
tools.description: List a status page's scheduled maintenances, most recent first — id, name, status, affected components, start/end, updates. Instatus: GET /v2/{page_id}/maintenances.

tools.name: instatus_get_maintenance
tools.title: Get maintenance
tools.description: Get a single scheduled maintenance by id — its full state including its update timeline and affected components. Instatus: GET /v1/{page_id}/maintenances/{maintenance_id}.

tools.name: instatus_update_component
tools.title: Update component
tools.description: UPDATES a component by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data. The key way to set a component's operational status (OPERATIONAL, UNDERMAINTENANCE, DEGRADEDPERFORMANCE, PARTIALOUTAGE, MAJOROUTAGE). Send only the fields you want to change. Instatus: PUT /v2/{page_id}/components/{component_id}. Returns the updated component.

order.description: Display order of the component on the page.

showUptime.description: Whether to show the uptime graph for this component.

grouped.description: Whether the component is displayed within a group.

tools.name: instatus_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident
tools.description: CREATES a new incident — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers. Provide `name` (required); optionally set the initial `message`, affected `components`, per-component impact via `statuses`, `status`, `started`, `notify`, and `shouldPublish`. Instatus: POST /v1/{page_id}/incidents. Returns the created incident.

components.description: Component ids affected by this incident.

started.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the incident started.

notify.description: Whether to notify subscribers about this update.

statuses.description: Per-component impact — set each listed component's status for this event.

status.description: The impact status to set on that component.

shouldPublish.description: Whether the incident should be published to the status page.

tools.name: instatus_update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: UPDATES an existing incident by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers (e.g. move it to MONITORING or RESOLVED). Send only the fields you want to change. Instatus: PUT /v1/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}. Returns the updated incident.

components.description: Component ids affected by this incident.

started.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the incident started.

notify.description: Whether to notify subscribers about this update.

statuses.description: Per-component impact — set each listed component's status for this event.

status.description: The impact status to set on that component.

shouldPublish.description: Whether the incident should be published to the status page.

tools.name: instatus_delete_incident
tools.title: Delete incident
tools.description: PERMANENTLY DELETES an incident by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and cannot be undone. Instatus: DELETE /v1/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: instatus_create_maintenance
tools.title: Create maintenance
tools.description: CREATES a new scheduled maintenance — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers. Provide `name` (required); optionally set `message`, affected `components`, per-component impact via `statuses`, `status`, `start`/`end`, `duration`, and `notify`. Instatus: POST /v1/{page_id}/maintenances. Returns the created maintenance.

components.description: Component ids affected by this maintenance.

start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the maintenance starts.

end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the maintenance ends.

notify.description: Whether to notify subscribers about this update.

statuses.description: Per-component impact — set each listed component's status for this event.

status.description: The impact status to set on that component.

components.description: Component ids affected by this maintenance.

start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the maintenance starts.

end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the maintenance ends.
